overview_description.description: Ambit Finance is a decentralized finance platform that provides cryptocurrency lending, borrowing, and yield-generation services. The platform allows users to deposit digital assets such as stablecoins, earn returns through lending strategies, and borrow against crypto collateral. It operates as a cross-chain protocol and includes products for stablecoin deposits, portfolio-based lending, leveraged positions, and risk-managed investment strategies.
